thread:
Maddie: quick follow-up on the service auth RFC — proposing a small roadmap for adopting narrow-scoped service tokens. TL;DR: phased rollout, token type v1 (project-scoped), v2 (fine-grained permissions), proxy path for cross-project calls.

Samir: +1 on phased. can we keep current svc tokens valid for 12 months then rotate to new model?

Dmitri: Need concrete mapping of "actor" -> project. If a long-running service owned by infra team should it be org-level or project-level? I worry about explosion of tokens.

Maddie: agree. proposal: default project-scoped tokens (service bound to project), opt-in org tokens for infra-owned shared services, and ephemeral exchange for cross-project via token broker. Example exchange flow:
```
1) svc A (proj X) calls broker
2) broker issues short-lived token scoped to proj Y with least privileges
3) svc A calls svc B with that token
```

Toni: How do we enforce RBAC for broker-issued tokens? We need audit & max-lifetime, and permission proofs.

Maddie: Broker will mint tokens with "actor" claim + "aud" + "scope" and a proof field referencing original principal. Audit logs link to parent token id.

Samir: Regarding SDKs, can we add token-exchange helper in runtime clients? that will cut adoption friction.

Carla: One tradeoff: extra latency on first exchange. Maybe cache exchanged tokens per call target for short TTL.

Dmitri: Also consider ACLs per route — not just model-level. e.g., "inference:create" vs "inference:manage-models". need RBAC mapping table.

Maddie: Agreed. I'll add a section to RFC: permission atoms, mapping table, broker APIs, SDK helpers, migration timeline (12mo compatibility window). Can we get reviews on the draft by EOD Friday?

Samir: I'll take infra review.

Toni: Security will review policy proof format and HSM KMS integration.

Carla: Ping me for SDK bits, I can prototype exchange helper next week.

infra-bot: deploy-check failed on token-broker feature branch — failing integration tests for scope propagation (link: https://ci.redwood.example/1234)

Maddie: noted, thanks infra-bot. I'll triage tests with @Samir.
